description:
Stick Ranger is a unique 2D action RPG developed by Dan-Ball.
Assemble a team of rangers, customize their classes, and battle through a variety of stages filled with enemies.

1.0.0.description:
# Stick Ranger integration for Archipelago

## Table of Contents

1. [Getting Started](#getting-started)
    - [Prerequisites](#prerequisites)
    - [Installation](#installation)
2. [AP Integration](#ap-integration)
    - [Goal](#goal)
    - [Locations](#locations)
    - [Items](#items)
    - [Progression](#progression)
    - [Options](#options)
3. [Saving & Persistence](#saving--persistence)
4. [Roadmap](#roadmap)
5. [Contributing](#contributing)
6. [License](#license)
7. [Contact & Support](#contact--support)
8. [Acknowledgements](#acknowledgements)
9. [Local Web Server Help](#local-web-server-help)

---

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

List any software or hardware requirements, e.g.:

-   A modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge...) (Only tested in Firefox)
-   Local web server

### Installation

-   Download the APworld for Stick Ranger
-   Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a yaml or download the one in here
-   Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a game
-   Run your local web server (Running "Archipelago Mod.html") (Need help? See [Local Web Server Help](#local-web-server-help))
-   Connect to and play the game (http://127.0.0.1:5500/Archipelago%20Mod.html)

## AP Integration

### Goal

The goal of the game is to complete the Hell Castle stage

### Locations

Checks are send when:

-   You complete a stage
-   You buy a book

### Items

You can receive:

-   Stage unlocks
-   A random item (any weapon/compo)

### Progression

Progression is locked into 5 zones:

-   Everything before Castle
-   Everything before Submarine Shrine
-   Everything before Pyramid
-   Everything before Ice Castle
-   Everything after Ice Castle

### Options

At the moment there are no options yet

## Saving & Persistence

-   **IndexedDB** store name: `StickRangerAP`
-   **Object store**: `savegames`
-   **Key structure**:
    ```
    [hostname]:[port]:Stick Ranger:[slotName]
    ```
-   Auto-save triggers:
    -   Receiving items
    -   Sending checks

## Roadmap

-   [x] Initial Release
-   [ ] Additional yaml options
-   [ ] DeathLink
-   [ ] Book shop buy item preview
-   [ ] Send commands/chat via chat window
-   [ ] Traps
-   [ ] Enemy/item randomizer

## Contributing

Feel free to contribute or mod

## License

This project is licensed under the **[MIT License](LICENSE)**. Feel free to use, modify, and distribute.

## Contact & Support

Please contact inside the Archipelago Discord, inside the Stick Ranger post inside future-game-design, or contact Kryen112 on Discord directly

## Acknowledgements

-   Thanks to Dire Storm from the Dan-Ball Discord for making a Vanilla Translation Mod

## Local Web Server Help

For easy setup of a local web server, do the following:

-   Install [Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/)
-   Install the [Live Server](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items/?itemName=ritwickdey.LiveServer) extension inside Visual Studio Code
-   Open the "Archipelago Mod" folder inside Visual Studio Code
-   Click ![go_live_image](assets/go_live.png) in the bottom-right of Visual Studio Code
-   A tab on your preferred browser will now open on http://127.0.0.1:5500/Archipelago%20Mod.html, running the game!

---

1.1.0.description:
## Installation

-   Download the APworld for Stick Ranger
-   Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a yaml or download the one in here
-   Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a game
-   Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)

## Changes
- Updated the logic, dead-locks (Stages being locked behind themselves) should not happen anymore (lets hope inside loops too, untested)
- Town-like locations (Village, Resort, Island, Forget Tree) are now marked as Useful instead of Progression 
- Rename a completion of a stage from "Stage" to "Stage Exit" for clarity
- Either Opening Street Exit or Opening Street Book must give an early level. (Grassland 1-4 or Hill Country 1)
- Added yaml Options for goldMultiplier, xpMultiplier and dropMultiplier
- Improved the client at https://github.com/Kryen112/Kryen112.github.io

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Kryen112/AP_Stick_Ranger/compare/1.0.0...1.1.0

## Installation

## Changes

### APWorld
- DeathLink
- Traps
  - -50% Gold: Lose half of your gold
  - Unequip items: Unequipes you Rangers' weapons to the inventory or mouse
  - Kill a Ranger: Speaks for itself
  - Freeze Rangers: Freeze all rangers for a random amount of time
  - Spawn enemies: Spawn a random amount of random enemies
- New Options
  - ShopHints: To enable/disable the Book shop sending out hints for you and the receiving player
  - BookCostRandomizer: Multiple options to randomize Book costs

### Client
- Upgraded to newest Archipelago.js package
- Dan-Ball font is available and set as the standard (with a switch to return to monospace)
- Chat window is bigger and resizable
- Chat window shows connection info and disconnect button
- Chat window allows for sending chats and '!'-commands
- New favicon
- Selected Ranger Selector can be the AP logo, and is set as the standard
- A lot of state and stability issues are fixed

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Kryen112/AP_Stick_Ranger/compare/1.1.0...1.2.0

## Changes

### APWorld
- New Options
  - book_shuffle: Whether or not Book buys are shuffled
  - enemy_shuffle: Whether common, boss or both types of enemies are randomized
    - Either one of these needs to be active
  - Better location names
  - Code refactor

### Client
- When shuffle_enemies is enabled, enemies have a chance to drop an AP item (with custom icon!)
  - Progress on which enemy the AP item is collected for is next to their health bar or inside the Book shop
- shuffle-books is also now an option in here

1.4.0.description:
## Installation

-   Download the APworld for Stick Ranger
-   Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a yaml or download the one in here
-   Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a game
-   Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)

## Changes

### APWorld
- New Options
  - class_shuffle: Whether classes are shuffled. Unlocks 1 class at the start and adds 7 class unlocks to the item pool. When enabled, Forget Tree is unlocked from the start.
  - Forget Tree now has the option to select classes. This will keep all your progress but your classes can be chosen at will!
  - Randomization used now uses the AP seed randomization.
  - Improved generation chances of success with multiple Stick Ranger games (still not fully working)
    - For a chance of a fail to happen you would need only Stick Ranger games with minimal locations in the generation which have different accessibility settings.

### Client
- Player colours in chat correspond to colours in a text client
- Drop chances when enemy_shuffle is enabled are increased to 15% for common enemies and 50% for boss enemies (to be balanced later, e.g. the yellow fish enemies in Cavern 1/2/3)
- Saving did not remember which enemies sent checks already, causing them the drop AP items again which did nothing, is now fixed
- Most actions now add a console.log, for debugging purposes if anyone ever encounters issues
- Sometimes, saving and loading would not remember stages beaten/booked correctly, now fixed
- Full-screen now works on all devices!
- Click and Touch functionality is now the same, meaning playing on Mobile is now working correctly!
- Data is saved on Archipelago's DataStorage, meaning if ports change, your info is remembered. Also allows for cross-device playing!
- Upon choosing "New Game", consistency in item-giving is now fixed
- Class selection is now limited whenever class_shuffle is enabled
  - You can change classes at the Forget Tree when you unlock more classes (also when shuffle_classes is not enabled)
  - Forget Tree is unlocked at the start when class_shuffle is enabled
- Overall improvements in stability of many functionalities 

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Kryen112/AP_Stick_Ranger/compare/1.3.0...1.4.0

1.6.0.description:
## Installation

-   Download the APworld for Stick Ranger
-   Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a yaml or download the one in here
-   Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a game
-   Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)

## Heads up

-   **Requires Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer.** The apworld now ships the
    `archipelago.json` manifest that Archipelago 0.7.0 will require, which also
    clears the "Invalid or missing manifest file" warning on generation.
-   **Regenerate your yaml.** The five "Classes required for ..." options changed
    meaning: they now count your starting class, so the range is 0-8 and a value
    of 1 means "no extra classes needed". An old yaml still generates, it just
    asks for one class fewer than it used to.

## Changes

### APWorld

-   Volcano and Mountaintop no longer forget to require their own stage unlock.
    Generation was free to place "Unlock Volcano" inside Volcano, which made the
    seed impossible.
-   With Class Randomizer off, the class requirements are now sent to the client
    as 0. They were sent raw, so the client demanded 2-6 classes you could never
    get and every boss stage stayed out of logic forever.
-   Class requirements are clamped so a later boss never asks for fewer classes
    than an earlier one, and the clamped values are what the client receives.
-   Goal-based location exclusion now works. It compared location names against
    item names, so it never excluded anything.
-   Packaged with Archipelago's own "Build APWorlds" component: manifest
    included, no stale __pycache__ in the archive (98 KB -> 30 KB).
-   Rewritten to current Archipelago world conventions, with item and location
    name groups and a grouped player-options page.
-   Real logic tests plus CI on every push.

### Client

-   The world map's stage colours now match Archipelago's logic. Six things were
    wrong:
    -   tallies counted stages **beaten** instead of unlocks **held**;
    -   the town/boss/goal stage lists never matched, so Castle, Submarine
        Shrine, Pyramid and Mountaintop counted as ordinary region stages;
    -   Opening Street counted towards the Castle gate despite having no unlock;
    -   region gates hung off "boss beaten" instead of that boss's own
        requirements, so beating a boss early opened the next region;
    -   boss gates never required their own stage unlock;
    -   the unlocked-class list grew on every reconnect, so class gates were
        effectively always satisfied.
-   A stage dot no longer inherits the previous stage's colour.
-   archipelago.js 2.0.4 -> 2.1.0, vite 6 -> 8.

1.7.0.description:
## Installation

-   Download the APworld for Stick Ranger
-   Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a yaml or download the one in here
-   Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a game
-   Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)

## Heads up

-   **Requires Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer.** The apworld now ships the
    `archipelago.json` manifest that Archipelago 0.7.0 will require, which also
    clears the "Invalid or missing manifest file" warning on generation.
-   **Regenerate your yaml.** Two options changed meaning since 1.5.0:
    -   `traps` now takes `none / 5 / 10 / 20 / 50 / 100`. The old `some`,
        `half`, `most` and `all` are gone, so an old yaml fails generation with
        an unknown-value error rather than silently doing something different.
    -   the five "Classes required for ..." options now count your starting
        class, so the range is 0-8 and 1 means "no extra classes needed".
-   Item names are now capitalised and carry their tier, e.g. `lightsaber` is
    `Lightsaber 2`. If your yaml names items in `start_inventory` or
    `local_items`, update them.

## New options

-   **Shop Checks** — buying each of the 462 shop items for the first time is a
    check. The shop shows an Archipelago logo until you have collected it, and
    the real item afterwards. Buying drops the logo on the floor; leave town
    without picking it up and the check does not count (the gold is still spent).
-   **Progressive Shop** — the shop's stock is opened by 32 Progressive Shop
    items instead of by beating stages, in every town rather than just the first.
-   **Free Respec** — the Forget Tree is always free, not only with Class
    Randomizer on.

## Changes

### APWorld

-   Volcano and Mountaintop no longer forget to require their own stage unlock.
    Generation was free to place "Unlock Volcano" inside Volcano, which made the
    seed impossible.
-   With Class Randomizer off, the class requirements are now sent to the client
    as 0. They were sent raw, so the client demanded 2-6 classes you could never
    get and every boss stage stayed out of logic forever.
-   Class requirements are clamped so a later boss never asks for fewer classes
    than an earlier one, and the clamped values are what the client receives.
-   The boss requirements rolled at generation are handed back to Universal
    Tracker, so the tracker stops rolling its own numbers and disagreeing with
    the seed about what is in logic.
-   Four lightsabers shared one name, and the item table is keyed by name, so
    three of them could never be created or sent. Names now carry their tier.
-   Goal-based location exclusion now works. It compared location names against
    item names, so it never excluded anything.
-   Packaged with Archipelago's own "Build APWorlds" component: manifest
    included, no stale `__pycache__` in the archive.
-   Rewritten to current Archipelago world conventions, with item and location
    name groups and a grouped player-options page.

### Client

-   The world map's stage colours now match Archipelago's logic. Six things were
    wrong:
    -   tallies counted stages **beaten** instead of unlocks **held**;
    -   the town/boss/goal stage lists never matched, so Castle, Submarine
        Shrine, Pyramid and Mountaintop counted as ordinary region stages;
    -   Opening Street counted towards the Castle gate despite having no unlock;
    -   region gates hung off "boss beaten" instead of that boss's own
        requirements, so beating a boss early opened the next region;
    -   boss gates never required their own stage unlock;
    -   the unlocked-class list grew on every reconnect, so class gates were
        effectively always satisfied.

    If you previously saw Mountaintop and Volcano sitting yellow while Universal
    Tracker disagreed, or Submarine Shrine in logic while Submarine 4 was not,
    those should be gone. Please report it if you still see either.
-   **Level 99 is reachable again.** The guard that stops a kill granting two
    levels assumed the XP curve continued past level 98, and capped the team at
    4,949,999 when reaching 99 needs 9,999,999.
-   **Town is no longer a softlock.** Reviving required someone already standing,
    leaving town needs a living ranger to walk to the sign, and Game Over only
    restores LP inside a stage — so a party wiped in town by the Kill a Ranger
    trap was stuck for good. A wiped party can revive now, free if it cannot pay.
-   Item names in the message log are coloured by flag bits, so an item that is
    both progression and useful no longer renders as filler.
-   The Gold Medal multiplies the gold multiplier instead of being added to it:
    5x with a +100% medal is 10x, not 6x.
-   The Bronze Medal raises the AP check drop rate as well as normal loot.
-   The spawn-enemies trap no longer spawns diggers, which could burrow away
    unkillable.
-   The Forget Tree is genuinely free with Class Randomizer on; it charged $1.
-   Connection details are remembered between sessions.
-   Mouse and touch handlers use `addEventListener`, so browser extensions that
    assign `document.on*` can no longer break the game. Thanks to
    **SunsetQuasar** ([#1](https://github.com/Kryen112/Kryen112.github.io/pull/1)).
-   archipelago.js 2.0.4 -> 2.1.0, vite 6 -> 8.

1.8.0.description:
## Installation

-   Download the APworld for Stick Ranger
-   Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a yaml or download the one in here
-   Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a game
-   Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)

## Heads up

-   **A game already in progress will lose its map colours.** The website updates
    for everyone at once, and from now on the seed itself tells the client what
    is in logic. A seed generated before 1.8.0 does not carry that, so its stages
    show simply as unlocked or completed. Everything else keeps working, and a
    new seed gets the colours back.
-   **Regenerate your yaml** for the new options below.
-   Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.

## New options

-   **Enforce Logic** — stages that are out of logic cannot be entered at all.
    They stay on the map, greyed out, so you can still see what you hold. There
    is no override: the run cannot be broken by accident or on purpose.
-   **Ring Link** — your gold is linked to every other Ring Link player's rings.
    Gold you earn sends rings to the room, rings you receive become gold, and
    spending sends a negative. **Ring Link Ratio** (default 100) sets how much
    gold one ring is worth in both directions, because Stick Ranger's gold is
    one to two orders of magnitude larger than the ring counts games like Sonic
    deal in.
-   **Gold per Thrown Ring** — every ring an Angel throws pays gold. Defaults to
    50, and goes up to 1000. Set it to 0 to turn it off. It ignores the Gold
    Multiplier and the Gold Medal, so the number you pick is the number you get.
    Be aware that an Angel throws about two rings a second, or seven on a quick
    ring, and four of them at the maximum out-earns every enemy in the game.

## Changes

### Logic now comes from the seed

The website used to carry its own copy of the apworld's rules, written by hand
and kept in step by hand. That is what went wrong six different ways in 1.6.0.

The apworld now describes its own logic and sends it with the seed, and the
website evaluates that instead of a copy. There is no second set of rules left to
drift. Checked by comparing 25,500 stage verdicts against Archipelago's own
answer across 300 random item states.

This is why an older seed loses its colours: it never sent a description.

### APWorld

-   Universal Tracker gets the boss requirements the seed actually rolled, so it
    stops rolling its own and disagreeing with the game.
-   New: Enforce Logic, Ring Link, Ring Link Ratio, Gold per Thrown Ring.

### Client

-   Every movement of gold now goes through one place, which is what Ring Link
    watches. What it reports is what actually happened, so a purchase you could
    not afford or a pickup at the gold cap sends nothing.
-   Ring Link batches: gold moves constantly here, so instead of a packet per
    change it totals up and sends at most one every five seconds. The total is
    added up before being divided, so ten $40 gun shots count as 4 rings rather
    than ten lots of nothing, and the remainder carries to the next send.
-   Gold arriving from Ring Link is never sent back out, so two linked Stick
    Ranger players cannot amplify each other.

1.8.1.description:
## Installation

-   Download the APworld for Stick Ranger
-   Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a yaml or download the one in here
-   Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a game
-   Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)

## Heads up

-   **If you are playing a seed with Shop Checks right now, reload the page and
    carry on.** You do not need a new seed, a new yaml, or the new APworld. The
    website has already updated.
-   Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.

## Shop Checks never worked

Shop Checks has been broken since it was added in 1.7.0, for everyone, on every
seed. Buying an item never sent its check.

The APworld built all 462 shop locations correctly, which is why they showed up
in the tracker and could be released by hand. But it never told the website the
option was on, and the website treats an option it was not told about as off. So
the shop behaved exactly like vanilla and quietly sent nothing.

Thanks to the player who reported this.

### Your run is not lost

A seed generated before this release still does not say whether Shop Checks is
on, so the website now works it out from the seed itself: only Shop Checks
creates locations in the shop range. If they are there, the feature is on.

So an in-progress run recovers on its own. Reload the page and buying starts
sending checks. **No regeneration.**

If you already released your shop checks by hand, the website now takes the
server's word for which ones are done, so those items go back to being ordinary
purchases instead of asking to be checked again. You will not pay for something
that is already gone.

### Also

-   New APworld tests assert that every option the website acts on actually
    reaches it. That is the check that was missing, and it is what let this ship
    in the first place.

1.8.2.description:
## Installation

-   Download the APworld for Stick Ranger
-   Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a yaml or download the one in here
-   Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago
-   Generate a game
-   Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)

## Heads up

-   **Nothing to do.** No gameplay change, no option change, no seed change. If
    you are on 1.8.1 you are already up to date; the website has updated itself.
-   The APworld is identical to 1.8.1 apart from its version number, so there is
    no need to re-download it or regenerate anything.
-   Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.

## Changes

### Client

-   Removed ten leftover values the website set on connect and then never read.
    They were the boss class and stage requirements, which the website stopped
    using in 1.8.0 when it started evaluating the logic the seed ships. Leaving
    them in made it look like those gates were still wired up by hand, which is
    exactly the confusion that caused the 1.6.0 logic bugs.
-   The save is no longer fetched with an argument that was being read as a
    "watch this key" flag, so the server stops echoing a notification back on
    every single save.

Both are housekeeping following the 1.8.1 audit. Nothing you can see changed.
